page: Microsoft Azure D48ads_v6 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, running at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with a 2835 GB local disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data shows strong multi-core performance, with Geekbench multi-core scores reaching the top tier (top 10%). Stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, along with Passmark CPU and memory evaluations, consistently place in the top 25%. Cryptographic and vector operations are accelerated by hardware support for AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16, and VAES. Memory bandwidth for cached small blocks is strong, though uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average category.

While the instance performs strongly in Redis SET operations (63.99 million operations per second) and database operations, it exhibits clear performance tradeoffs under heavy computational loads. LLM inference speeds for small 135M models are strong, but text generation for large 70B models drops to a poor rating of 2.52 tokens per second. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for relational databases, software compilation, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, whereas large-scale deep learning text generation represents a performance bottleneck.
